items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: Mr. Dave tried to learn the music, but he, you know, he couldn't.

ctx.x: What was he like before he took out traffic? Was he playing anything else?

No, well, you see, Lewis was a kind of bad boy, you know. See, he first was out of one thing, then another. Used to sell charcoal, had charcoal schooners on the old New Basin Canal. I guess you heard about that. But he was selling charcoal out there, you know. As a kid, you know, see. Well, he wouldn't go to school. And they would pick him up and put him in jail, you know, juvenile delinquency. You know, see. The last time they put Lewis in jail, it kept him in there for indefinite legacy. Well, that's how he…
Did he sing when he was young?
